newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet prices slightly weaker, premiums stable.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet prices slightly weaker, premiums stable.

text.p: European jet fuel prices were slightly weaker on Friday in line with benchmark gas oil futures though barge and cargo premiums remained stable.
Traders said business was still very thin and limited to the odd barge here and there as the volatile gas oil screen restricted demand to top up parcels only.
Barge premiums were assessed steady around August IPE +$16/18 a tonne fob ARA, confirmed by trade on Thursday at +$17 fob Rotterdam.
Cargoes talked August IPE +$17/+$19 a tonne cif NWE.
In the Med most refiners had only small jet parcels to offer and interest was mainly focused on next month's Libyan programme with the few larger cargoes around highly priced.
Brokers said high freight costs were restrictive and putting together combination cargoes was proving very difficult.
